a3af1b6abd2c685cf34f14a3a9b93793296750e9.name: telephony

Use whenever the user asks to phone/call/ring someone or a number. NOT for video calls, SMS, or reading past call history.

a3af1b6abd2c685cf34f14a3a9b93793296750e9.name: devops

a3af1b6abd2c685cf34f14a3a9b93793296750e9.description: The user's own LIA application settings: saved font size, theme, language, timezone, personality and feature preferences.

a3af1b6abd2c685cf34f14a3a9b93793296750e9.name: peer
a3af1b6abd2c685cf34f14a3a9b93793296750e9.description: Connections with OTHER USERS of this LIA instance: relay a message to a connected user through their assistant, list connections, check a connected user's shared availability or tasks. NOT for the user's own address book (use contact) nor their own calendar (use event).

a3af1b6abd2c685cf34f14a3a9b93793296750e9.name: document_generation
a3af1b6abd2c685cf34f14a3a9b93793296750e9.description: Create downloadable documents (CSV, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, PDF, Markdown, text) from instructions and optional data. Use when the user asks for a file, an export, a report document, a spreadsheet or a presentation. NOT for images.

a3af1b6abd2c685cf34f14a3a9b93793296750e9.name: memory
a3af1b6abd2c685cf34f14a3a9b93793296750e9.description: What LIA REMEMBERS about the user from past conversations: their preferences, the people in their life, habits, significant events, standing instructions they gave. Search it for a fact about the user that the request does not settle. Search only: remembering something new needs no tool (memories are extracted from the conversation automatically). NOT the address book (use contact), NOT the user's documents (use document).

a3af1b6abd2c685cf34f14a3a9b93793296750e9.name: journal
a3af1b6abd2c685cf34f14a3a9b93793296750e9.description: LIA's OWN journal: what LIA noted for itself from past conversations with the user — how to work with them (directives), patterns it observed, facets of its portrait of the user. Use when the user asks what LIA noticed, learned or noted about them, or to recall how LIA should handle a subject. NOT the user's memories (use memory), NOT their documents (use document).

a3af1b6abd2c685cf34f14a3a9b93793296750e9.name: calculation
a3af1b6abd2c685cf34f14a3a9b93793296750e9.description: Exact computations the model must NOT do in its head: arithmetic (totals, percentages, VAT, unit prices, splits, averages, interest), date and time arithmetic (days until a date, ages, weekdays, adding days or business days, time zone conversion) and currency conversion at the published reference rate. Use it whenever an answer states a computed figure, a computed date or a converted amount. NOT for looking data up (use the domain that holds it).

a3af1b6abd2c685cf34f14a3a9b93793296750e9.name: activity
a3af1b6abd2c685cf34f14a3a9b93793296750e9.description: What LIA itself DID and CONSULTED for the user, from its transparency registers: the actions it performed (messages sent, events created, notifications) with their outcome, and the data it read, over a period. Use for 'what did you do for me', 'did you send it', 'what did you do on your own'. NOT the user's own calendar or tasks (use event, task).

a3af1b6abd2c685cf34f14a3a9b93793296750e9.name: generated_file
a3af1b6abd2c685cf34f14a3a9b93793296750e9.description: The files LIA PRODUCED for the user — generated images and documents, browser screenshots, images a connection shared — found again and shown in the chat. NOT the user's Drive files (use file), NOT creating a new image or document (use image_generation, document_generation).
